name: webmcp-kit
description: Coding-agent plugin that adds WebMCP (document.modelContext) tools to a web app: reads the repo, proposes a reviewable tool plan, waits for approval, implements against @nekuda/webmcp-sdk, and verifies every tool in a real browser. When a site already has working tools, it connects those instead — moving their registration onto the SDK without rebuilding them. Runs locally — your code never leaves your machine.

skills.description: Add WebMCP tools to a website: read the repo, propose a tool plan, wait for approval, implement against @nekuda/webmcp-sdk, and verify each tool in a real browser.
Check that a locally running site's WebMCP tools register and execute correctly, on the right pages and auth states.

Connect a site's existing WebMCP tools to AgentLane without rebuilding them: detect the current registrations, inventory them, migrate the registration layer to @nekuda/webmcp-sdk with durable stable keys, and verify behavior is unchanged.
